# A component calling a method of a node its own body renders, through the
# `#id` its body wrote, means its own copy of that node wherever it is. The
# copies shared the handle the checker declared, so with one spliced in place
# and others built at run time under a `for`, html refused the call as one
# that could not say which copy it meant -- the Pokédex's retries, each an
# openapi adapter's `refresh` calling its query's.
#
# unbound.sngl leaves the query's `pending` and `failure` unbound, so the
# query moves into a wrapper holding them and its `#id` moves with it. The
# handle is still the body's own: bubbletea refused the call as one that could
# not say which copy it meant, so the Pokédex's cards bound every prop they
# did not read.

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go app.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go app.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=none unbound.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=html unbound.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go unbound.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go unbound.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go unbound.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
import async "sngl:async"
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

var asked list[string] = []

func lookup(name string) async.Result[int] {
    asked.push(name)
    return {ok=name.length()}
}

component asker(name string) ui.node {
    var length option[int] = null
    var pending = false
    var failure option[async.Failure] = null

    func again() {
        q.refresh()
    }

    async.query #q(on=name, fetch=lookup, :value=length, :pending=pending, :failure=failure)
    ui.button #retry(text="Again", @click { again() })
}

component pair ui.node {
    asker #first(name="fig")
    asker(name="kiwi")
    asker #second(name="lemon")
    for var n = ["plum", "pear"] {
        asker(name=n)
    }
}

func testEachCopyAsksAgain(t test.Test, c pair) {
    t.wait(func() => asked.length() == 5, 5000)
    c.first.retry.click()
    t.wait(func() => asked.length() == 6, 5000)
    t.assert(asked[5] == "fig")
    c.second.retry.click()
    t.wait(func() => asked.length() == 7, 5000)
    t.assert(asked[6] == "lemon")
}

ui.window {
    pair
}
-- unbound.sngl --
import async "sngl:async"
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

var asked list[string] = []

func lookup(name string) async.Result[int] {
    asked.push(name)
    return {ok=name.length()}
}

component asker(name string) ui.node {
    var length option[int] = null

    func again() {
        q.refresh()
    }

    async.query #q(on=name, fetch=lookup, :value=length)
    ui.button #retry(text="Again", @click { again() })
}

component pair ui.node {
    asker #first(name="fig")
    asker(name="kiwi")
    asker #second(name="lemon")
    for var n = ["plum", "pear"] {
        asker(name=n)
    }
}

func testEachCopyAsksAgain(t test.Test, c pair) {
    t.wait(func() => asked.length() == 5, 5000)
    c.first.retry.click()
    t.wait(func() => asked.length() == 6, 5000)
    t.assert(asked[5] == "fig")
    c.second.retry.click()
    t.wait(func() => asked.length() == 7, 5000)
    t.assert(asked[6] == "lemon")
}

ui.window {
    pair
}
